description: This topic explains the meaning and importance of entrepreneurship, the qualities and role of entrepreneurs, small and medium enterprises, how to start and plan a small business, and the challenges and solutions facing entrepreneurs in Tanzania.

options.text: The process of identifying business opportunities and starting a business to make profit
The process of working for a government salary every month
The act of saving money in a bank account
The buying of shares on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange

mcq.explanation: Entrepreneurship is the process of spotting business opportunities, taking risks and organising resources to start and run a business for profit.

options.text: A person who only buys goods for personal use
A person who starts and runs a business by taking risks to earn profit
A person employed to keep records in an office
A person who inspects business licences for the government

mcq.explanation: An entrepreneur is a person who organises resources, takes risks and starts a business in order to make profit.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is a key quality of a successful entrepreneur?

options.text: Creativity and willingness to take calculated risks
Waiting for others to make all decisions

mcq.explanation: A successful entrepreneur is creative and is willing to take calculated risks to turn ideas into profitable businesses.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following best shows the role of entrepreneurs in the economy?

options.text: They create jobs and reduce unemployment
They increase the number of unemployed people
They stop the use of local resources
They reduce the variety of goods in the market

mcq.explanation: Entrepreneurs set up businesses that employ people, which creates jobs and reduces unemployment in the economy.

mcq.questionText: What does the abbreviation SME stand for?
mcq.explanation: SME stands for Small and Medium Enterprise, a business with relatively few workers and small capital.

mcq.questionText: Which document guides an entrepreneur on how the business will be started and run?
mcq.explanation: A business plan is a written document describing the business idea, objectives, market, capital and how the business will operate.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is usually the first step in starting a small business?
mcq.explanation: Starting a business begins with identifying a viable business idea before planning, raising capital and choosing a location.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is a common challenge facing small businesses in Tanzania?

options.text: Lack of enough capital to expand
No customers anywhere in the country

mcq.explanation: Many small businesses in Tanzania struggle to access enough capital and credit, which limits their growth and expansion.

mcq.questionText: What is the main difference between an entrepreneur and a manager?

options.text: An entrepreneur is always poor while a manager is always rich
A manager owns the business while an entrepreneur is only employed
An entrepreneur owns the business and bears the risk, while a manager is employed to run it
There is no difference between the two

mcq.explanation: An entrepreneur owns the business and takes the risk for profit or loss, while a manager is an employee paid to run the business on behalf of the owner.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is an advantage of self-employment over paid employment?

options.text: A fixed monthly salary regardless of performance
Freedom to be your own boss and keep all the profit
No need to make any business decisions

mcq.explanation: In self-employment the person is their own boss and keeps the profit, unlike paid employment where one earns a fixed salary.

mcq.questionText: Why is innovation considered an important role of entrepreneurs?

options.text: It increases the prices of all goods in the market
It introduces new products and better methods of doing business
It reduces the number of products available to consumers
It removes the need for any workers

mcq.explanation: Through innovation, entrepreneurs introduce new products, services and improved methods, which benefit consumers and the economy.

mcq.questionText: A trader in Kariakoo borrows money from a SACCOS to expand her clothing business. This shows that the entrepreneur is solving which challenge?
mcq.explanation: Borrowing from a SACCOS or microfinance institution is a common way entrepreneurs raise capital to overcome shortage of funds.

mcq.questionText: Which legal requirement must many small businesses obtain before they begin trading?
mcq.explanation: A business licence is a legal permit allowing a person to operate a business; many traders also register with BRELA and TRA for a TIN.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a quality of a successful entrepreneur?
mcq.explanation: Successful entrepreneurs are hard-working, confident, decisive and show initiative; laziness and lack of initiative are weaknesses, not qualities.

mcq.questionText: How do small and medium enterprises (SMEs) help the Tanzanian economy?

options.text: They reduce the variety of goods available to people
They provide employment and use local resources to produce goods
They discourage all forms of saving
They prevent people from earning income

mcq.explanation: SMEs employ many people, use local resources, supply goods and services and contribute to government revenue and economic growth.

fib.questionText: A person who starts and runs a business while taking risks for profit is called an _____.
fib.explanation: An entrepreneur organises resources and bears the risk of starting and running a business.

fib.questionText: The process of identifying opportunities and starting a business to earn profit is known as _____.
fib.explanation: Entrepreneurship is the act of spotting opportunities and organising a business venture for profit.

fib.questionText: The written document that guides how a business will be started and operated is called a business _____.
fib.explanation: A business plan describes the idea, objectives, market, capital and operations of the business.

fib.questionText: The abbreviation SME stands for Small and Medium _____.
fib.explanation: SME means Small and Medium Enterprise, a business with small capital and few workers.

fib.questionText: The money or assets used to start and run a business is called _____.
fib.explanation: Capital is the funds and resources needed to start, operate and expand a business.

fib.questionText: Working for oneself instead of for an employer is known as _____ employment.
fib.explanation: Self-employment means a person runs their own business rather than earning a salary from an employer.

fib.questionText: The legal document that allows a person to operate a business is called a business _____.
fib.explanation: A business licence is a legal document allowing the holder to carry out business activities.

fib.questionText: The willingness to take chances even when the outcome is uncertain is called _____ taking.
fib.explanation: Risk-taking is a key entrepreneurial quality, since starting a business involves uncertainty about profit or loss.

fib.questionText: An employee who is paid to run a business on behalf of the owner is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A manager is hired to run the business and earns a salary, while the entrepreneur owns it and bears the risk.

fib.questionText: The ability to come up with new and original ideas is called _____.
fib.explanation: Creativity allows entrepreneurs to develop new products and better methods of running a business.

tf.questionText: An entrepreneur is a person who takes risks to start and run a business for profit.
tf.explanation: Yes, an entrepreneur organises resources and bears risk in order to earn profit.

tf.questionText: Entrepreneurs help the economy by creating jobs and reducing unemployment.
tf.explanation: By starting businesses that employ workers, entrepreneurs create jobs and reduce unemployment.

tf.questionText: A successful entrepreneur must avoid taking any kind of risk.
tf.explanation: An entrepreneur takes calculated risks; avoiding all risk would mean never starting a business.

tf.questionText: A business plan is only needed after a business has already closed down.
tf.explanation: A business plan is prepared before and during the running of a business to guide its operations.

tf.questionText: SMEs in Tanzania provide employment and use local resources.
tf.explanation: Small and medium enterprises employ many people and make use of locally available resources.

tf.questionText: Lack of capital is one of the major challenges facing small businesses in Tanzania.
tf.explanation: Shortage of capital and limited access to credit is a common challenge for small businesses.

tf.questionText: A manager owns the business and takes all the profit and loss.
tf.explanation: The entrepreneur owns the business and bears profit or loss; the manager is an employee paid a salary.

tf.questionText: In self-employment, a person earns a fixed monthly salary from an employer.
tf.explanation: In self-employment the person runs their own business and keeps the profit; a fixed salary belongs to paid employment.

tf.questionText: Strong competition from other traders can be a challenge for small businesses.
tf.explanation: Many small businesses sell similar goods, so competition can reduce sales and profit.

tf.questionText: Innovation by entrepreneurs leads to new products and improved methods of doing business.
tf.explanation: Through innovation, entrepreneurs introduce new and better products and ways of working.

summary.correctAnswer: Entrepreneurship is the process of identifying business opportunities, taking risks and organising resources to start and run a business for profit.
summary.explanation: It captures opportunity-spotting, risk-taking and resource organisation aimed at profit.

summary.questionText: State three qualities of a successful entrepreneur.
summary.correctAnswer: Creativity, willingness to take calculated risks and hard work (also confidence, initiative and good decision-making).
summary.explanation: Successful entrepreneurs combine creativity, risk-taking, hard work, confidence, initiative and good decision-making.

summary.questionText: Give three roles of entrepreneurs in the economy.
summary.correctAnswer: Creating jobs, bringing innovation, and creating wealth while using available resources.
summary.explanation: Entrepreneurs reduce unemployment, innovate, create wealth and use local resources productively.

summary.questionText: What is a small and medium enterprise (SME)?
summary.correctAnswer: An SME is a business with relatively small capital and few employees that produces or sells goods and services.
summary.explanation: SMEs are smaller businesses important for employment and use of local resources.

summary.questionText: List the main steps in starting a small business.
summary.correctAnswer: Get a business idea, prepare a business plan, raise capital, choose a good location, and obtain licences.
summary.explanation: These are the basic steps: idea, plan, capital, location and legal licences.

summary.questionText: Name three components of a simple business plan.
summary.correctAnswer: Business idea or description, market analysis, and financial plan or capital requirements (also objectives and management).
summary.explanation: A simple plan describes the business, its market, finances, objectives and how it will be managed.

summary.questionText: State three challenges facing entrepreneurs and small businesses in Tanzania.
summary.correctAnswer: Lack of capital, strong competition, and lack of business skills (also poor market access).
summary.explanation: Common challenges include shortage of capital, competition, low skills and limited markets.

summary.questionText: Suggest two solutions to the challenges facing small businesses in Tanzania.
summary.correctAnswer: Access loans from SACCOS or microfinance institutions, and attend entrepreneurship training to improve business skills.
summary.explanation: Raising capital through credit and gaining skills through training help overcome key challenges.

summary.questionText: Explain the difference between an entrepreneur and a manager.
summary.correctAnswer: An entrepreneur owns the business and bears the risk for profit or loss, while a manager is an employee paid to run the business.
summary.explanation: Ownership and risk-bearing separate the entrepreneur from the salaried manager.

summary.correctAnswer: In self-employment a person runs their own business, is their own boss and keeps the profit, while in paid employment a person works for an employer and earns a fixed salary.
summary.explanation: The contrast lies in ownership, independence and how income is earned.

hoq.questionText: Two young people in Mwanza both sell fried fish near the lake. One keeps selling the same way and makes little profit, while the other starts smoking and packaging the fish for sale in Dar es Salaam and earns much more. Which entrepreneurial quality best explains the second person's success?
hoq.explanation: By finding a new way to add value and reach a bigger market, the second person shows creativity and innovation, key entrepreneurial qualities.

hoq.questionText: A new entrepreneur in Arusha wants to open a small bakery but has only enough money to buy ingredients, not an oven. According to good business practice, what should she include in her business plan to address this?

options.text: A financial plan showing how she will raise capital for the oven through savings or a loan
A decision to start without any oven and hope for the best
A plan to ignore the cost of equipment completely
A statement that capital is not needed in business

hoq.explanation: A sound business plan includes a financial section that identifies capital needs and how they will be met, such as through savings or a loan from a bank or SACCOS.

hoq.questionText: A factory in Tanga is owned by Mr. Juma, who supplies the capital and takes the profit or loss, while Ms. Neema is paid a monthly salary to supervise the workers and daily operations. Which statement correctly describes their roles?

options.text: Both are entrepreneurs because they both work in the factory
Mr. Juma is the manager and Ms. Neema is the entrepreneur
Mr. Juma is the entrepreneur who bears the risk, and Ms. Neema is the manager who is employed to run it
Neither of them has any role in the business

hoq.explanation: The owner who supplies capital and bears profit or loss is the entrepreneur, while the salaried supervisor employed to run operations is the manager.
